name: Control a bicycle for 15 minutes
short_description: Start, steer, brake, and stop a bicycle during a 15-minute ride.
self_assessment: I can control a bicycle for 15 minutes without help on a traffic-free route.
description: Start, steer, brake, and stop a bicycle during a 15-minute ride. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
safety_note: Falls and collisions can cause injury; wear a fitted helmet, check the bicycle, and use a traffic-free practice area.
